summary: The verified first-stage artifact is only a partial solution for the second-stage repair goal. The core obstruction is the edge zero-transverse-frequency shifted magnetic invariant. Constructive routes split into source-model restrictions, shifted-variable damping/MPML modifications, and CFS or split-field repaired models.

insights.title: The obstruction is a kernel invariant, not polarization
insights.idea: In an x-edge layer with sigma_x>0 and sigma_y=0, the verified linear-growth mode is generated by the undamped shifted magnetic variable M_x=Q_x+mu*(sigma_x/epsilon_0)*H_x on the transverse zero mode. Since the obstruction has E=P=P_z=0, changing only Debye or fractional polarization cannot remove it.
insights.why_non_obvious: The source equations contain many PML auxiliaries, but the exact obstruction collapses to a two-variable magnetic Jordan block. This reframes the repair problem around a single edge-kernel invariant.
insights.falsification_test: Freeze edge coefficients, Fourier transform transversely, and check whether any nonzero transverse mode has a Jordan block or positive real eigenvalue.

insights.title: Compatibility should target only the transverse kernel
insights.idea: A compatibility repair for the original source equations should exclude the zero-transverse-mode projection of M_x on x-edges and M_y on y-edges, rather than requiring the shifted variable to vanish pointwise.
insights.why_non_obvious: The full edge equation can generate M_x from partial_y E, so pointwise M_x=0 is not dynamically invariant. The zero transverse projection is the part that survives as the verified free invariant.
insights.falsification_test: For constant x-edge coefficients, derive the transverse Fourier symbol. In the simplified magnetic-electric edge subsystem, nonzero k modes factor as (lambda+b)(epsilon lambda^2+k^2/mu)=0, while k=0 contains the linear-growth block.
evidence_needed: Formal Fourier proof including polarization coupling
Boundary-condition treatment for the transverse zero projection

insights.title: Edge-positive shifted damping removes the Jordan block
insights.idea: Modify the shifted equation to M_t=source-gamma M with gamma>0 in the edge. The zero-mode subsystem H_t=M/mu, M_t=-gamma M admits a positive quadratic Lyapunov functional with a cross term.
insights.why_non_obvious: Plain energy mu H^2/2+c M^2 has an indefinite H M derivative, so the repair is easy to miss unless one searches for a Lyapunov matrix with off-diagonal terms.
insights.falsification_test: Verify P>0 and A^T P+P A<=0 for A=[[0,1/mu],[0,-gamma]] using P=[[p,p/(mu gamma)],[p/(mu gamma),q]] with q>p/(mu^2 gamma^2).
evidence_needed: Frozen nonzero-mode Lyapunov or semigroup check
Definition of the modified MPML/CFS damping in source variables

insights.title: CFS/split field is the arbitrary-data repair route
insights.idea: For arbitrary displayed-variable data, the original source equations cannot be repaired by proof technique alone. A CFS or split-field model with positive frequency shifts should be tested because it moves the zero-frequency memory pole and should remove the free shifted magnetic invariant.
insights.why_non_obvious: It changes the problem class, so it should not be mixed with claims about the original source model. But it directly addresses the pole-level cause of the verified obstruction.
insights.falsification_test: Derive the repaired constant-coefficient edge and corner symbols and search for a positive Lyapunov matrix across frozen Fourier modes.
evidence_needed: Physical-space energy closure under constant or controlled variable coefficients

candidate_facts.claim_summary: For the constant x-edge magnetic-electric subsystem, after excluding the transverse zero mode, the simplified symbol factors as one damped mode and one undamped oscillator pair rather than a Jordan growth block.
Adding positive damping to the edge shifted magnetic variable gives a positive quadratic Lyapunov functional for the zero-mode H-M subsystem.

For arbitrary eight-variable edge-PML data in the original source equations, any monotone or uniformly bounded repair must either restrict the undamped shifted magnetic invariant or modify the PML memory dynamics.
